title: TEM Analysis Detail
description: Detail block for TEM hasPart items. Discriminates on ada:componentType, carries analysis-level required properties and an @id reference to a registered temTAPP definition, and per-dataset schema:additionalProperty entries constrained via $refs to the parameterValues registry plus a catch-all. Generated by tools/build_tapp.py.

items.description: @id reference to a registered temTAPP TAPP definition.

ada:analyst.description: Name of the analyst who conducted the analysis session.

ada:analysisStartDate.description: Date on which the analysis session began.

ada:analysisEndDate.description: Date on which the analysis session ended (if spanning multiple days).

ada:fundingSourceForAnalysis.description: Grants and funding that supported this analytical campaign (distinct from protocol development funding). Include grant IDs.

ada:sampleName.description: Name or identifier of the sample or TEM section analyzed in this session.

ada:edsDetectionLimit.description: Estimated detection limits for key target analytes by EDS under this protocol conditions.

ada:edsDeadTime.description: Percent dead time reported by the EDS detector during the session — the fraction of total acquisition time the detector spent processing rather than counting. EDS dead time correction is managed automatically by the SDD detector electronics; this field documents the resulting percentage as a session QC metric. Values above ~40% indicate excessive count rate and may degrade spectral quality and quantitative accuracy.

ada:eelsSensitivityAndDetectionLimit.description: Practical energy resolution (ZLP FWHM measured at operating conditions) and estimated detection limit or minimum detectable concentration for target edges under this protocol.

anyOf.title: Coupled Protocol DOI
anyOf.description: DOI of the registered protocol for the coupled technique.

anyOf.title: Coupled Dataset or Publication Reference
anyOf.description: DOI of the dataset or publication containing the coupled technique data.

anyOf.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
anyOf.description: Persistent identifier (e.g., IGSN) for the sample analyzed.

anyOf.title: Accelerating Voltage
anyOf.description: Electron beam accelerating voltage in kilovolts (kV). For beam-sensitive materials (organic matter, phyllosilicates), 60–80 kV may be used to stay below the displacement threshold for C, N, O, and S. The protocol specifies the standard operating voltage; analysts record and justify deviations.

anyOf.title: Analytical Sub-mode
anyOf.description: Sub-mode(s) of imaging or diffraction performed under this protocol. TEM Imaging options: BF-TEM, DF-TEM, HRTEM, EFTEM. STEM Imaging options: HAADF, ABF, BF-STEM, ADF, MAADF. Electron Diffraction options: SAED, CBED, Nanobeam diffraction, Precession ED, 4D-STEM. Multiple values apply when the protocol covers more than one sub-mode within a given analytical mode.

anyOf.title: TEM Objective Aperture
anyOf.description: Objective aperture diameter used to select the imaging beam condition in TEM mode. In BF-TEM, a small aperture blocks diffracted beams to enhance mass-thickness contrast; in DF-TEM, the aperture is displaced to select a specific diffracted beam; in HRTEM, no aperture is typically used.

anyOf.title: EFTEM Energy Window
anyOf.description: Energy window(s) used for EFTEM elemental mapping: center energy, width, and acquisition method (three-window or jump-ratio).

anyOf.title: HAADF Collection Angles
anyOf.description: Inner and outer collection angles of the HAADF detector in milliradians (mrad). The inner angle determines the boundary between diffracted and thermally diffuse scattered electrons; larger inner angles yield stronger Z-contrast and reduced Bragg contrast.

anyOf.title: STEM Probe Diameter
anyOf.description: Nominal or measured diameter of the focused electron probe at the sample, reported in nm. Serves as a direct spatial resolution proxy for STEM imaging and STEM-EDS/EELS analysis. Related to, but distinct from, Convergence Semi-Angle: the two quantities are connected via aberration coefficients, defocus, and probe current, which are not always published. Report whichever is known; if both are known, report both fields.

anyOf.title: STEM Probe Current
anyOf.description: Probe current in picoamperes (pA) or nanoamperes (nA). Higher current improves EDS/EELS signal but increases beam damage risk, especially for organic matter and hydrous minerals.

anyOf.title: STEM Dwell Time per Pixel
anyOf.description: Time spent acquiring signal at each pixel during STEM scanning in milliseconds. Longer dwell improves signal-to-noise but increases total specimen dose; for dose-sensitive materials, minimize dwell and compensate with frame averaging.

anyOf.title: STEM Scan Dimensions
anyOf.description: Number of pixels in the STEM scan frame (X × Y pixels). Combined with calibrated pixel size, defines the field of view.

anyOf.title: STEM Frame Averaging
anyOf.description: Number of frames averaged (with drift correction if applicable) to produce the final STEM image. Averaging reduces noise while limiting per-frame dose.

anyOf.title: Camera Length
anyOf.description: Nominal camera length in millimeters used for diffraction pattern acquisition. Controls the mapping between reciprocal-space scattering angle and detector position; must be calibrated to convert pixel distances to d-spacings. In STEM mode, also sets HAADF/ABF detector collection angles.

anyOf.title: Selected-Area Aperture Size
anyOf.description: Diameter of the selected-area aperture used in SAED mode, defining the specimen region that contributes to the diffraction pattern.

anyOf.title: Precession Angle
anyOf.description: Precession semi-angle in degrees for precession electron diffraction (PED). Hollow-cone illumination reduces dynamical diffraction effects and produces more kinematical-like intensities. Not applicable to SAED, CBED, or standard 4D-STEM.

anyOf.title: 4D-STEM Scan Grid and Area
anyOf.description: Number of probe positions in the 4D-STEM dataset (scan pixels × scan pixels) and the physical area covered. Probe step size is the physical area divided by scan pixel count.

anyOf.title: 4D-STEM Dwell Time per Probe Position
anyOf.description: Time spent acquiring each diffraction pattern in the 4D-STEM dataset in milliseconds. Longer dwell improves signal-to-noise for weakly diffracting phases (e.g., smectite 001 reflection at ~1.24 nm) but increases total specimen dose; risk of beam damage to phyllosilicates and organic matter must be balanced against data quality.

anyOf.title: Diffraction Camera Length Calibration Method
anyOf.description: Method used to calibrate the camera length constant and convert pixel distances in diffraction patterns to d-spacings or reciprocal lattice vectors.

anyOf.title: EDS Acquisition Mode
anyOf.description: Mode of EDS data acquisition.

anyOf.title: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel
anyOf.description: EDS spectral acquisition live time per analysis point (point/line mode) or per pixel (spectrum image) in seconds. Also referred to as "EDS Acquisition Time" in EPMA and some SEM-EDS contexts, where the per-pixel distinction is less relevant.

schema:name.const: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel

anyOf.title: EDS Energy Range
anyOf.description: Energy range of EDS spectrum acquisition in keV.

anyOf.title: EELS Acquisition Mode
anyOf.description: Mode of EELS data acquisition.

anyOf.title: EELS Edges
anyOf.description: Ionization edge(s) acquired by EELS, specified by element symbol and edge label (e.g., Fe L2,3; O K). Provides the EELS-specific counterpart to the Analyte field: while Analyte lists elements, EELS Edges documents which ionization edges were used and their approximate energy loss positions. The protocol registers the full intended edge suite; analysts confirm or narrow this list at analysis time.

anyOf.title: EELS Acquisition Time per Spectrum
anyOf.description: Exposure time per individual EELS spectrum (or per pixel for spectrum images) in seconds.

anyOf.title: EELS Energy Loss Range
anyOf.description: Energy loss range acquired, defined by onset energy and width in eV. The protocol documents the target range for the registered analyte edges; analysts record the actual range acquired.

anyOf.title: EELS Background Subtraction Method
anyOf.description: Method used to subtract the background beneath the ionization edge of interest to extract the net edge signal.

anyOf.title: EELS Plural Scattering Correction
anyOf.description: Method applied to correct for multiple inelastic scattering events (plural scattering) that broaden edge fine structure. Critical for specimens thicker than ~0.5 inelastic mean free paths.

anyOf.title: Image Processing Methods Applied
anyOf.description: Image processing steps applied to TEM or STEM images during or after acquisition. Non-linear processing steps that could affect quantitative interpretation should be documented explicitly.

anyOf.title: Specimen Thickness Determination Method
anyOf.description: Method used to estimate TEM foil thickness. Required for EELS quantification (log-ratio) and for assessing multiple-scattering severity.

anyOf.title: EDS Calibration Standard(s)
anyOf.description: Reference material(s) used to validate EDS quantification or determine experimental k-factors or zeta-factors. TEM-EDS is less standardized than EPMA; many protocols rely on manufacturer k-factors without external calibration.

anyOf.title: EELS Energy Calibration
anyOf.description: Method and reference used to calibrate the EELS energy axis. Accurate calibration is required for ELNES edge identification, chemical-state analysis, and inter-lab comparability.

anyOf.title: Diffraction Calibration Reference
anyOf.description: Reference material or internal standard used to calibrate the electron diffraction camera constant (camera length × electron wavelength), enabling conversion of pixel distances to d-spacings.

anyOf.title: EDS Counting Statistics / Accumulation Criterion
anyOf.description: Quality criterion used to determine when sufficient EDS signal has been accumulated for a given pixel or point, in lieu of or in addition to a fixed live time. Expressed as a target relative uncertainty on major-element peak counts achieved by accumulating successive scan frames (e.g., "1% counting statistics on major elements"; ">10% counting statistics"). Distinct from EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel, which records a fixed-duration setting.
Catch-all for additional schema:PropertyValue entries beyond the temTAPP-derived catalog.
